title: Usage pipeline: move the Console usage writer to hourly batches
creator: Logan Wright
description: Summary: The per-request usage writer cannot keep up with Q1 traffic: the Console usage page falls behind by hours during peaks and the backfill job double-writes on retry. Move the writer to hourly batches. Batched usage is complete and exact but appears in the Console up to 60 minutes after the request. Support's missing-usage threshold changes with the cut-over (Dev Patel to update the routing page). Plan: 1) Build the hourly batch writer behind a flag; write to a shadow table and compare totals for two weeks. 2) Freeze the per-request writer and switch the Console usage page to the batch table. 3) Cut over at a month boundary so no invoice period mixes both writers. 4) Remove the per-request writer and the backfill job. Acceptance: Shadow totals match the per-request writer to the token for 14 consecutive days. Every successful request appears on the Console usage page within 60 minutes. No invoice period contains usage from both writers.
comments: Nadia Rahman: shadow totals matched for 16 days (2027-02-08 to 2027-02-23).
Logan Wright: cut-over scheduled for the March boundary, 2027-03-01 00:00 UTC.
Nadia Rahman: cut-over completed 2027-03-01 00:00 UTC. All requests made from then on are written by the hourly batch writer. Per-request writer frozen; backfill job removed.
Logan Wright: Dev confirmed the routing page change. Closing.
